compute_loss_and_metrics: compute loss statistics and metrics for classification or regression tasks with optional model uncertainty
normalize_regression_loss: normalize MSE regression loss by dividing by expected squared error assuming uniform x in [-1,1]
get_all_metric_names: get all scalar metric names produced by compute_loss_and_metrics for a given task type and config
get_std_factor_from_confidence_percent: get the standard deviation factor from a confidence percentage using scipy normal distribution
mse_loss: compute the mean squared error between predicted values and target values
